feature: SharedChannel owned pump with scan-cached deadlines

candidate.design: A sole-owner pump variant accepted an absolute output deadline and skipped the per-pump exact clock validation for internally derived read deadlines. The worker passed outputDeadline() computed from the scan-cached awake timestamp.

scope.workload: SharedChannel shared-unary persistent round trip, 262144-byte request and response

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

conclusion: Removing the pump's exact clock reads did not change wall time beyond noise. The source change was reverted; the accepted request ownership and duplex burst changes remain.
